t: Lean Python Widgets: Using Rich with FastHTML/HTMX for Server-Generated UI
s: This article explores building lean, server-driven web UIs using Python, specifically integrating Rich for visually appealing component generation within FastHTML/HTMX frameworks to accelerate development and minimize JavaScript complexity.
sub: Leveraging Rich for HTML fragment generation with `export_html(inline_styles=True)`.
Server-driven UI development to avoid heavy client-side JavaScript frameworks.
AI-assisted development for accelerating workflow implementation and creating clear code surface areas.
Strategic avoidance of premature complexity ('rabbit holes') like AnyWidgets initially.
